request: Choose a premium hero for our calm editorial product. Keep our light palette; mobile readers matter.
check: Translate premium into the existing brief, not a literal search or dark/3D style. Inspect varied actual sections and relevant mobile evidence. Explain a choice using hierarchy, content fit and action clarity; identify unverified coverage without claiming a universal winner.

request: Recommend a premium interactive 404. One capture only shows a loader; another has a complete still but no recording.
check: Do not recommend hidden behavior from a loader or invent motion from the still. The still may support composition. Find actual interaction evidence or state the gap; preserve a clear recovery route and distinguish visible link appearance from verified navigation.

request: Build a new premium button interaction for our playful brand, with touch and keyboard support. Do not copy an existing animation.
check: Inspect real clips, derive useful principles and explain an original proposed behavior without claiming global novelty. Preserve the brand and scope; implement and verify interruption, input methods and reduced motion. Do not stop at a search list or claim tests were completed from a poster.

request: The top-rated clip looks impressive but has no relevant mobile evidence. A lower-rated one fits our navigation task. Which should we use?
check: Treat ratings as discovery input, compare actual task fit and inspected behavior, and distinguish missing mobile evidence from proven failure. Do not mechanically select the highest rating or fabricate numerical beauty/confidence scores.

request: Recommend an excellent hero for an editorial product. Use our saved reviews, explain the fit, and state any missing evidence.
check: Read the human editorial reason and caveats, inspect pixels, and separate the curator observation from contextual fit. If no reviews match, broaden to ordinary evidence without inventing scores. Do not inherit the website rating for the hero.
